research:
Usage (Basketball-Reference 2025-26): Brown 36.2% (traded to PHI), Cunningham 30.5%, Tatum 30.0% (16 games after Achilles return Mar 6), Simons 23.7, Duren 23.6, P. George 23.3 (PHI), White 22.0, Pritchard 21.4. Only Cade and Tatum clear 24%. Opening week, so last-season logs are used, adjusted for Brown's exit.
DvP: RotoGrinders' cheat sheet (FanDuel scoring, undated) has BOS 28th vs PG (42.6), 8th SF, 4th PF, and DET 26th vs SF, 20th PF. Rank direction and season are unconfirmed. BOS led the NBA in opponent ppg (107.2) and DET was 4th (109.7), so both gates are borderline.
Cade 2025-26 log (64 games): 23.9/5.6/9.9. 93% lines are 10+ pts (95.3%), 2+ reb (93.8%), 6+ ast (93.8%). He also had 7+ ast 90.6%, 9+ ast 68.8%, 20+ pts 68.8%. Vs BOS: 25/3/8, 42/8/5, 32/4/10, 16/3/14.
Tatum post-return (16 games): 21.8 pts, 10.0 reb, 5.3 ast in about 32 min, with 14+ pts 15/16, 5+ reb 15/16, 2+ ast 15/16. BetMGM notes R+A 14.5 cleared in 6 of 7 without Brown. Hard Rock notes 27+ vs DET in 8 straight meetings.
Totals (craftednba 2025-26 final): BOS ORtg 120.0 / DRtg 111.7 / pace 95.6; DET ORtg 117.3 / DRtg 108.9 / pace 99.9. Avg poss = 97.75.
BOS = avg(120.0 x 0.9775 = 117.3, 108.9 x 0.9775 = 106.4) = 111.9; DET = avg(117.3 x 0.9775 = 114.7, 111.7 x 0.9775 = 109.2) = 111.9. Projected total 223.8 vs DK 219.5 (o-115). TheSpread and SI show 222.5 and another book 221.5, so 219.5 is the low number.
Caveats on the total: Boston's 120 ORtg included Brown (36% usage), now swapped for Paul George. Detroit lost Tobias Harris and Isaiah Stewart and added John Collins, Isaiah Joe, Gary Harris and Taurean Prince. Opening-day 3pm ET rust could also cut scoring.
Injuries: BOS Devin Carter out (mononucleosis, several weeks). DET Taurean Prince out per ESPN (personal; earlier listed questionable/doubtful). Tatum and Cunningham carry no designation.
Rosters and chemistry: Boston traded Brown to PHI for Paul George plus picks and signed Mitchell Robinson (3 yr) and Mike Conley (1 yr). Core is Tatum, White, Pritchard, George, Queta/Robinson. Detroit, 60-22 and East No. 1 seed last year, re-signed Duren (reported 5 yr/$200M) and extended Ausar Thompson. Its win total is 49.5 vs Boston's 51.5.
Coaching: Mazzulla runs the league's slowest pace (95.6) on 3-point volume and switching. J.B. Bickerstaff's Pistons play faster (99.9) and physical, with an elite rim defense. Early-season minutes for Tatum may be managed after the Achilles (he sat a back-to-back last spring).
Market: DK BOS -1.5, ML BOS -125 / DET +105, total 219.5 (o-115/u-105). Props: Tatum pts 26.5 (bet365 -112/-112), reb 8.5 (BetRivers -114; another book -130/-105); Cade pts 24.5 (bet365 -115/-110), ast 8.5 (FanDuel -136), 10+ ast +125 (TheSpread), ladder 20+ pts -380 / 5+ reb -200 / 7+ ast -500 / 10+ ast +120 (LasVegasSportsBetting).
Experts: Covers takes Cade u24.5 pts (proj 21.1). Dimers projects Tatum about 23 pts. SBR and SportsBettingDime take Tatum o8.5 reb. FanDuel Research takes Cade o8.5 ast. BetMGM takes Tatum o14.5 R+A.
Most likely leg to win: Cade o6.5 assists (90.6% last season). Strongest edge vs price: Over 219.5, 4.3 pts under projection and 2-3 pts below other books.
